user.title: Set up Roy's Net Meter
user.description: Choose which kind of meter you have. See the README for the full explanation of each option.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this setup.
data_description.meter_type: A net grid meter reports the net import/export flow through your grid connection. A consumption meter (e.g. an RCBO/breaker with built-in metering) reports your home's total consumption directly.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Roy's Net Meter
reconfigure.description: Update the name or meter type for this setup. See the README for the full explanation of each option.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this setup.
data_description.meter_type: A net grid meter reports the net import/export flow through your grid connection. A consumption meter (e.g. an RCBO/breaker with built-in metering) reports your home's total consumption directly.

grid_meter.title: Net grid meter entities
grid_meter.description: Select the entities from your net meter, CT clamps, and inverter that this integration needs.

data_description.gen_amp_entity: The sensor reporting your solar inverter's AC output current (A). Compared against the consumption current sensor to decide whether you're importing or exporting.
data_description.con_amp_entity: The sensor reporting the amperage (A) of your home's main incoming line, typically from a CT clamp.
data_description.flow_power_entity: The net real power (W) reported by your net meter, e.g. an ESPHome Home Assistant Glow device.
data_description.flow_energy_entity: The net real energy (kWh) reported by the same net meter.
data_description.gen_power_entity: Your solar inverter's AC output power (W).
data_description.gen_energy_entity: Your solar inverter's total generated energy (kWh).
data_description.max_power: A power reading above this (or negative) is treated as a bad sample and replaced with the last known-good value, rather than corrupting the running energy totals. This is different from the sensor being unavailable, which still shows up as such. Set above your highest real load.

consumption_meter.title: Consumption meter entities
consumption_meter.description: Select the entities from your consumption meter and inverter that this integration needs.

data_description.con_power_entity: The sensor reporting your home's total real-time power consumption (W), e.g. from a metering RCBO/breaker.
data_description.con_energy_entity: The sensor reporting your home's total accumulated energy consumption (kWh), from the same device.
data_description.gen_power_entity: Your solar inverter's AC output power (W).
data_description.gen_energy_entity: Your solar inverter's total generated energy (kWh).
data_description.max_power: A power reading above this (or negative) is treated as a bad sample and replaced with the last known-good value, rather than corrupting the running energy totals. This is different from the sensor being unavailable, which still shows up as such. Set above your highest real load.

error.unknown: Could not read one or more of the selected entities. Make sure they all exist and have a value, then try again.
